t.ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule.
t.ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN.eff.0: Rare cases of allergic contact dermatitis after using creams have been reported. CIR found it safe at current use concentrations.
t.ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN.summary: A skin conditioning agent and deodorant.
t.ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN.what: According to CosIng it acts as a skin conditioning agent and deodorant; it often appears together with phenoxyethanol in preservative blends.
